page.overview:
What is The Unforgiven II?

The Unforgiven II is the fourth track on ReLoad. It is a sequel to "The Unforgiven".

Just like its original version, The Unforgiven, the subject matter also deals with the theme of unforgiveness. It talks about the struggle to forgive a friend who has betrayed your deepest trust. The lyrics, like "She loves me not, she loves me still, but she'll never love again," show a strong desire for love mixed with a sad expectation of loss, highlighting serious trust issues. It’s about wanting to share feelings ("what I've felt / What I've known") but not being able to do so completely, and having a hard time accepting someone who reflects the same brokenness he sees in himself. The "you" in the song represents someone who also has deep scars from society, making them similar in their pain, but this shared experience makes forgiveness even harder.

Lay beside me, tell me what they've done Speak the words I want to hear, to make my demons run The door is locked now but it's opened if you're true If you can understand the me, then I can understand the you

Lay beside me, under wicked skies Through black of day, dark of night, we share this paralyze The door cracks open but there's no sun shining through Black heart scarring darker still, but there's no sun shining through
